name: Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47
description: Waveshare ESP32-C6 board with an on-board 1.47" 172x320 ST7789 SPI LCD, a WS2812 RGB LED and a microSD slot. Two 9-pin headers, 0.7 in apart, straddle a breadboard channel. The LCD is hard-wired to the chip (MOSI 6, SCLK 7, CS 14, DC 15, RST 21, BL 22) - drive it from a script with lcd_init(6, 7, 14, 15, 21). WireLab talks to it over the native USB Serial/JTAG port.
notes: Outline 36.37 x 20.32 mm without the USB-C plug (Waveshare dimension drawing). Drawn LCD side up, USB-C at the bottom.
Headers: 2x9 at 2.54 mm, rows 17.78 mm (7 holes) apart, pin nearest the USB-C 11.31 mm from that edge. On a breadboard it straddles the channel in rows C and H.
Left header from the USB end: 5V, GND, 3V3 (out), GPIO0-GPIO5. Right header: TX (GPIO16), RX (GPIO17), GPIO13, 12, 23, 20, 19, 18, 9.
On-board 1.47" ST7789 LCD (172x320) on SPI: MOSI GPIO6, SCLK GPIO7, CS GPIO14, DC GPIO15, RST GPIO21, backlight GPIO22. None of these reach the headers.
On-board WS2812 addressable RGB LED on GPIO8 (not on the headers) - drive it with rgb(r, g, b).
microSD/TF slot shares the LCD SPI bus: MOSI GPIO6, MISO GPIO5, SCLK GPIO7, CS GPIO4. GPIO4 and GPIO5 are on the header too.
BOOT pulls GPIO9 low; RST pulls the chip EN line. Both buttons and the RGB LED sit on the back; WireLab draws them below the glass so they stay clickable.
Free for your own wiring: GPIO0-GPIO3 (ADC1), GPIO18-GPIO20 and GPIO23. GPIO12/13 are the USB D-/D+ lines.
specs: 2x9 header, 2.54 mm pitch, 17.78 mm row spacing
